Great! / It worked! / I did it!

qudu2fx3ncc.source: はい、ありがとうございます。

qudu2fx3ncc.reference: Yes. People often tell me that our play looks similar, so I'll work hard to become even more like him.

qudu2fx3ncc.translateGemma12B: This way, we're currently in third place for the Audishacker, but it was perfect.
qudu2fx3ncc.translateGemma4B: Despite being third in line as an auditor, this was completely satisfactory.

qudu2fx3ncc.reference: Is the next team going to be okay after this?
qudu2fx3ncc.source: 感動した。 次のチーム大丈夫かって。

qudu2fx3ncc.translateGemma4B: I was moved. Is the team going to be okay?

qudu2fx3ncc.reference: There is still another match coming up.
qudu2fx3ncc.source: はい、ありがとうございます。 まだね、次の試合ありますから。
qudu2fx3ncc.translateGemma12B: Yes, thank you very much. There's still another match coming up, so...
qudu2fx3ncc.translateGemma4B: Yes, thank you. We still have another game coming up.

qudu2fx3ncc.source: え、マジで感動した。 え、わかる。
qudu2fx3ncc.translateGemma12B: Wow, I'm really touched. I understand.
qudu2fx3ncc.translateGemma4B: Wow, I was really moved. Um, I understand.
